text:
anna_sales: Linda (Acme) asking if we can do a 5-week air-gapped POC in their colo. Requirements: customer HSM signing, weekly minibundles, no vendor key custody, estimated ~50GB/week. Quick take?

conor_se: Yes. We ship unsigned minibundles + a signing-helper container that runs in their network. Need HSM vendor + pkcs11 details.

mei_infra: Chunked diffs ok. Pinning drivers increases size. Recommend weekly non-migration deltas, monthly fulls. Preflight: disk, container runtime, HSM access.

diego_sec: Must add SOW line: "Customer retains exclusive custody of private keys. Redwood will not receive or persist private key material." Audit logs must remain in-customer.

linda_acme: Acme uses Luna and will run tooling in a locked jumpbox. They want rollback playbook and pricing for weekly handling.

conor_se: Draft signing command (runs inside jumpbox):
```
docker run --rm -v /artifacts:/a redwood/sign-tool:latest sign \
  --bundle /a/minibundle.tar.gz --pkcs11 /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so \
  --slot 0 --pin-file /run/pin --out /a/minibundle.sig
```

mei_infra: We'll add health-check canary (10/50/100%) + auto-revert on failure to avoid DB rollbacks.

conor_se: Pricing proposal: one-time packaging $16k + per-minibundle handling $550. Will refine after matrix tests.

pkg-bot: PKG-7777 created: sign-tool + luna pkcs11 example + preflight checklist.

anna_sales: Actions: @conor_se prototype sign-tool + docs, @mei_infra preflight one-pager, @diego_sec SOW wording. Meeting Fri 9am PT with Acme. :thumbsup:
